faq: Which platforms can you write for?
Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest and TikTok captions are the usual choices. Tell us your platforms and we adapt length and style for each, since one caption rarely suits all of them.
Will you post for me without asking?
No. Posts are drafted and loaded as scheduled drafts or sent to you for approval. If you want us to schedule them, you add us as a collaborator, never by sharing a password.
Can you use my product photos?
Yes. Send photos you own or have rights to, and we pair them with captions. We do not use stock images that you have no license for, and we do not fake customer photos.
Do you buy followers or likes?
Never. That breaks platform rules and does your account harm. We focus on useful posts, clear offers and timing, so your audience grows from real people.

desc:
Social media posts drafted in your voice keep your accounts active without taking over your week. Ecom Swift LLC writes the captions, hashtags and calls to action, builds a posting calendar and loads the posts into your scheduler for your approval.

## What does it mean to draft social posts in your voice?

Drafting social posts in your voice means writing captions that sound like your business, not like a generic account. We study how you speak, learn your products and offers and write posts that fit each platform. You approve every post, and nothing goes live without your yes.

The posts use your own approved photos and product details. We do not buy followers, fake engagement or post on your behalf without access you choose to grant.

## Why steady, on-brand posting matters

Social accounts work through repetition. A shopper who finds your page wants to see recent activity, a clear idea of what you sell and a tone that feels like a real business. An account that goes silent for weeks, or posts random content, gives them little reason to follow or buy.

Regular posts keep your name in front of people who already know you, and they give new visitors a quick way to judge your brand. A calendar helps because it spreads your offers, stories and everyday content across the month instead of bunching them together. Reach and sales still depend on the platform, your audience and your products, so we do not promise growth, but consistency gives your account a fair chance to work.

## What a good set of posts includes

- Captions with a strong first line, since most feeds cut the rest.
- A call to action that matches the goal of each post, such as visit, reply or save.
- Hashtags chosen for relevance, not volume.
- A mix of content types: products, offers, behind the scenes, tips and customer questions.
- Posts matched to your real offers and calendar of events.
- Suggested posting times and days for each platform.
- Ideas for stories and short video scripts, where the plan includes them.
- A campaign theme that links several posts around one message.
- A reply guide for common comments and questions.
- A simple chart of the content mix, so you can see the balance.

## How we work

You choose the platforms and tell us about your products, offers and tone. We draft captions with AI tools for speed, then a person rewrites each one for taste, accuracy and platform fit. We place the posts in your scheduler as drafts with a calendar, so you can read, change or remove anything.

The Basic package covers two weeks of posts for one platform with a calendar and a round of voice tweaks. Standard extends to a month across two platforms, loads the posts into your scheduler and suggests posting times. Premium adds a longer period, more platforms, a campaign theme, story and short video script ideas, a reply guide and a content mix chart. Add-ons include more posts, hashtag research and refreshes of old captions.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Use real photos of your products and your work.
- Answer comments and messages promptly.
- Keep a regular rhythm you can maintain.
- Mix helpful posts with sales posts.
- Review each post before it goes live.

**Avoid:**
- Posting only discounts.
- Using trending sounds or hashtags that do not fit your brand.
- Buying followers or likes, which can harm your account.
- Using images from other brands without permission.
- Letting a scheduled post run during a crisis without checking.

## Who this service is for

This service suits an owner who knows social media matters and keeps falling behind. It suits a shop launching a new range that needs a month of consistent content. It also suits a small team with one person handling everything who wants a first draft of each post to improve.

## What we need from you

Tell us your platforms, your products and offers, your tone and the photos you approve. Share a few past posts you liked. If you want posts loaded into a scheduler, add us as a team member or collaborator in that tool. We never ask for passwords, and we never post for you without your approval.
